releaseNotes: Long-press now selects whole messages instead of individual words, with a dedicated Copy action.
Telegram-style selection circles animate in from the left and highlight only selected message bubbles.
All mobile interface icons now use one consistent Tabler icon system.
Tab changes move directly between endpoints on the native UI thread without showing intermediate pages.
Hidden screens, chat rows, media sources and palette subscriptions are frozen or memoized to reduce Android frame drops.
Swipe-to-reply, recording pulse and selection motion now use lightweight UI-thread animations.
